name: disk_hygiene_data_roots_3152
comment: ANCHOR: LQ3152_DATA_ROOTS — the migration moved ~/tradeai-wt-* to /data/worktrees and left the home path as a
SYMLINK; discovery skips symlinks (is_dir(follow_symlinks=False)), so 182+ migrated worktrees were invisible to
G/W/C while /data grew unwatched. The patch registers /data/worktrees as a git root, marks .migration-records
never-touch, and treats the home symlink as a compatibility alias: the target is judged, the link is NOT a hold
(an active copy is held by its claim/cwd/activity; a completed copy past standing_apply.worktree.untouched_hours
is selectable and the executor unlinks the alias with it, per operator order 2026-11-14 00:25 ET), a real entry
where the alias belongs is held as shadowed (AGENTS.md rule 5, both paths reported), a dangling alias is a
report-only orphan_link row, claims and worklog references written against the alias hold the target (realpath
both sides), and the host pressure guard measures every disk_caps mount (/ and /data, bytes) by default.
Hermetic: temp roots with real git worktrees behind symlinks.
